source_caption:
Denis Villeneuve’s Arrival isn’t just about aliens -  it’s about us experiencing time, grief, and the way language shapes how we think. Fun fact: the heptapods’ circular language was designed by linguists and artists to visually represent the idea of non-linear time. That’s why every scene feels like a puzzle slowly falling into place..

Would you choose to know your future… even if it meant living through the pain?
